verdict.rationale: The official first-project guide walks through creating a project and an index, adding documents, and running a first search in the web interface. A one-line cURL install of a dependency-free single binary supports a fast start. Hands-on reports call it 'literally zero config', say it 'just worked' with 1M records, and describe setup as 'very easy', though one user said index creation and document upload took about a week of coding and hit low default upload limits. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the quickstart's elapsed time ('minutes' is only a marketing claim), and resolution of the one hands-on report of heavy ingestion effort and low upload limits.
